description: This file defines the internal class ClientGrainContext, which implements multiple interfaces related to grain context management in Orleans. It manages grain references, extensions, components, and lifecycle behaviors for client-side grain contexts.

classes.name: ClientGrainContext
classes.description: Represents a client-side grain context managing references, components, extensions, and lifecycle for grains in Orleans.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a component of specified type from the context or from the activation services if not present.

methods.name: GetTarget
methods.description: Returns the target object casted to the specified type, or default if not applicable.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Sets or removes a component of a specified type in the context.

methods.name: GetOrSetExtension
methods.description: Gets an existing extension or creates and sets a new one using the provided factory function.

methods.name: TryGetExtension
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an extension of the specified type; returns true if successful.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a registered extension of the specified type, or throws if not available.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Method intended to handle incoming messages; currently not implemented.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the grain context with a request context and cancellation token.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain context with a reason and cancellation token.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Rehydrates the context from a rehydration state; disposes of the state if disposable.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Handles migration logic; currently not supported.
